scope: isolated Magic Find candidate recomposed from stored inputs, with controlled fixtures; not a production profile and not a verified MF source
authorization: David authorized the probe on 2026-10-08 ("sonda si") after asking for a real-time Magic Find reading; the live read is reserved to the root session after reviewing this candidate.
binary_note: computed on the installed file on 2026-10-08; static analysis only

environment.dependencies: Python stdlib only; existing x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump for the static analysis; no installs, build, EXE or game access

red_guard.mutation: Disable both initial/final real buff manager identity guards only in the fixture process

offline_profile.negative_control: one guard hash and one slot target altered in memory only: exit 1, failures guard_local_player_getter and slot_controlled_character_getter

limitations: Game process never read; no real Magic Find, buff or luck value observed.
The client stores no total: the candidate repeats the widget's sum and inherits every rule this analysis may have misread.
Only the constant formula is evaluated; a counted Magic Find record with another formula, a game mode or a trait/state condition yields unknown.
The display cap is a content number and is not read; the candidate is emitted uncapped.
Whether real effects fit the byte budget is an estimate, not a measurement.
Fixtures use synthetic guard contents; only check_profile_offline.py ties the real hashes to the installed file.
Snapshots are not atomic; concurrent differences are rejected, not reconstructed.
The repository gate and plugin suite were not run; this folder is documentation outside the package.
evidence_paths: Repository-relative paths normalized in synthetic test logs; scratch disassembly was temporary and deleted
